title: Build Webhook Payload Visual Inspector Plugin
description: PostHog settings panel currently lacks a visual inspector for project webhooks. Build a clean React payload viewer component that polls webhook log API, renders JSON side-by-side, and includes re-delivery action.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Scaffold Next.js dashboard UI. Hour 2-3: Connect PostHog API & JSON tree component. Hour 4: Deploy Vercel demo & submit PR to Algora.

title: Create Next.js Realtime Storage Bandwidth Meter Widget
description: Developers need a lightweight storage meter widget for Supabase projects to visualize bucket egress in real-time.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Next.js setup with Recharts. Hour 2-3: Supabase JS SDK storage events integration. Hour 4: Live demo submission.

title: Unkey Edge Rate-Limiting Visual Middleware Extension
description: 48-Hour Solo Hackathon: Build a browser extension or middleware dashboard that visualizes Unkey API key rate limits and latency spikes.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: Next.js + Hono proxy layout. Hour 2-4: Key verification UI & rate-limit charts. Hour 5-6: Loom video demo & submission.

title: LLM Evaluation Score Export & Analytics Dashboard
description: Build an open-source evaluation exporter that reads Langfuse score metrics and exports formatted CSV/PDF summaries for AI teams.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: FastAPI Python backend adapter. Hour 2-3: React score table UI. Hour 4-5: Vercel deployment & PR link.

title: Kubernetes Pod Metrics Visual Timeline Component
description: Build a React Gantt-chart timeline component for Devtron dashboard parsing Kubernetes pod deployment logs into step-by-step visual bars.
senior_build_plan: Hour 1: React log parser component. Hour 2-4: Timeline chart rendering with Tailwind. Hour 5-6: Devtron PR submission.

title: 2-Day Paid Trial Sprint: Email Template Live Sandbox
description: Paid 2-Day Trial for Product Engineer Candidates: Build an interactive React Email live code editor sandbox rendering email HTML in real time.
senior_build_plan: Day 1: Next.js + Monaco Editor setup. Day 2: Real-time iframe preview & Vercel deployment. Direct CTO review.
